title: Abdel's Trusted Shield
summary: Protection from Missiles is an Action once per Short Rest. For 10 turns, ranged weapon attacks against you have disadvantage and deal half damage. Shield Bash. When hit by a melee attack, use a Reaction to attempt to knock the attacker Prone. A Dexterity save resists.
